title: AI Reconstructs Professional Networking: The Parent Company of WordPress Launches Android Version of Mesh, Creating a Cross-Platform Nexus AI Assistant
excerpt: Mesh, the personal CRM and relationship management platform under Automattic (formerly known as Clay), officially launched on Android platforms on August 12, 20
content_html:
Mesh, the personal CRM and relationship management platform under Automattic (formerly known as Clay), officially launched on Android platforms on August 12, 2026, supporting multi-screen adaptation, pop-up views, foldable screens, and real-time cross-device synchronization. It also accelerates the implementation of intelligent features such as Nexus AI.

This move marks that after Automattic's acquisition of Mesh, it further integrates generative AI with personal data asset management, redefining the paradigm of relationship management.

As a core technological highlight, the tested Nexus AI allows users to perform complex relationship asset searches through natural language, accurately answering specific queries such as particular company contacts, city distributions, or field experts. It also actively explores voice-free interaction and AI business card recognition technologies. In terms of strategic collaboration, Mesh has achieved interoperability with Automattic's multiple messaging applications, Beeper. In the future, it will leverage AI to cross over multiple social platforms such as WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and Slack, helping users with large networks efficiently maintain relationships.

In terms of commercialization and privacy protection, Mesh adheres to a subscription model. The free version offers a limit of 1,000 contacts, while the paid version supports unlimited storage and does not share user data for ad targeting. Currently, about 70% of its users apply it in commercial scenarios. From an industry trend perspective, Mesh's cross-platform expansion and AI empowerment reflect that CRM tools are rapidly evolving from static databases into intelligent human-computer collaborative assistants across all scenarios.

content_html_zh:
Mesh是Automattic（原名Clay）旗下的个人CRM和关系管理平台，于2026年8月12日在Android平台正式上线，支持多屏适配、弹出视图、可折叠屏幕、跨设备实时同步等。 它还加速了Nexus AI等智能功能的实现。

此举标志着Automattic收购Mesh后，将生成式AI与个人数据资产管理进一步融合，重新定义关系管理范式。

作为核心技术亮点，经过测试的 Nexus AI 允许用户通过自然语言进行复杂的关系资产搜索，准确回答特定的查询，例如特定公司联系人、城市分布或领域专家。 它还积极探索无语音交互和AI名片识别技术。 在战略协作方面，Mesh已经与Automattic的多个消息应用程序Beeper实现了互操作。 未来，它将利用AI跨WhatsApp、LinkedIn、Slack等多个社交平台，帮助拥有大人脉的用户高效维护关系。

在商业化和隐私保护方面，Mesh坚持订阅模式。 免费版本的联系人限制为 1,000 个，而付费版本则支持无限存储，并且不共享用于广告定位的用户数据。 目前约有70%的用户应用于商业场景。 从行业趋势来看，Mesh的跨平台扩展和AI赋能，体现了CRM工具正在从静态数据库快速演变为全场景的智能人机协作助手。
